title: Release Train Weekly Prep Notes - 2026-03-25
content:
Meeting: Release Train Weekly Prep (Go/No-Go)
Date: 2026-03-25
Time: 09:30-10:00 PT
Location: Zoom + #release-train Slack
Goal: Validate readiness for staged launch window on 2026-03-28 and confirm owners for final checklists, rollback criteria, and post-launch smoke tests.

Attendees (anticipated):
- Sofia Martinez (owner)
- Samir Patel (release lead)
- Maya Singh (Q/A & Evals)
- Liu Chen (Infra/Deploy)
- Priya Kapoor (Product / feature accept)
- On-call SRE (TBD)

Agenda:
1) Quick status round (1-2m each)
2) Go/No-Go checklist review (15m)
3) Blockers / last-mile risks + mitigations (8m)
4) Final owners + communication plan (5m)
5) Action items + next steps (2m)

Go / No-Go Checklist (current status) - call out yellow/red items with owner and notes:
- Feature flags: master toggles implemented and tested - OWNER: Samir Patel - STATUS: green - NOTES: Canary flag in prod ready, default off.
- Model version pinning and compatibility validated - OWNER: Maya Singh - STATUS: green - NOTES: New model quantization validated on staging, no regressions on key prompts.
- DB/schema migrations / data model changes - OWNER: Liu Chen - STATUS: yellow - NOTES: Migration script ready; dry-run completed in staging but need one more dry-run during low-traffic window (scheduled 2026-03-26 02:00 PT). Potential rollback plan documented.
- Infra capacity & autoscaling policy reviewed - OWNER: Liu Chen - STATUS: green - NOTES: Dedicated pools sized for expected qps; autoscale threshold adjusted per perf run.
- Observability & alerting configured (SLO dashboards, error budget) - OWNER: Samir Patel / SRE - STATUS: green - NOTES: Dashboard links in linked artifacts; alert thresholds discussed.
- Canary + rollout plan (steps, %s, time gaps) - OWNER: Samir Patel - STATUS: green - NOTES: Canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% across 3 windows, 30m gaps.
- Rollback criteria & automated rollback tested - OWNER: Liu Chen - STATUS: yellow - NOTES: Automated rollback triggers implemented; end-to-end test of rollback only partially exercised (need one more simulated rollback).
- Compliance / data privacy checks for private deployments - OWNER: Priya Kapoor - STATUS: green - NOTES: No new sensitive fields introduced; audit logs verified.
- Customer comms and internal runbook up-to-date - OWNER: Sofia Martinez - STATUS: green - NOTES: Draft status page message ready; runbook link included in artifacts.

Open Blockers / Risks (short list):
- Migration dry-run required (see above). Risk: if migration fails during launch window, rollback could require DB restore (~90min). Mitigation: schedule dry-run 3/26, ensure DB backups + warm standby. OWNER: Liu Chen, DUE: 2026-03-26.
- Partial rollback testing incomplete. Risk: unknown edge-case during automated rollback. Mitigation: execute one simulated rollback in staging during weekend maintenance. OWNER: Liu Chen, DUE: 2026-03-27.
- Load spike under folded caching scenario. Risk: sudden QPS burst could cause token cost spike and latency regression. Mitigation: increase initial autoscale headroom for first 60m after canary; enable circuit-breaker. OWNER: Samir Patel, DUE: 2026-03-28 (pre-launch).

Communications & Runbook:
- Status page copy: draft in confluence (linked). OWNER: Sofia Martinez. DUE: 2026-03-26 noon.
- Internal Slack rotation for launch day (who pings who): Samir to post canary start/stop messages; SRE to escalate if alerts fire. OWNER: Samir Patel.

Rollback Criteria (explicit):
- Error rate > 3x baseline across 2 consecutive 5m windows OR
- Latency P99 increase > 2x baseline sustained for 10m OR
- Data integrity issue confirmed by product/Q&A.
If any criteria met -> immediate automated rollback and notify exec oncall + release lead.

Post-launch smoke and validation (first 90 minutes):
- Run smoke tests from production traffic replay: OWNER Maya Singh - pass/fail within 15m of each rollout step.
- Verify key customer flows (auth, create request, generate response, billing ping): OWNER Priya Kapoor.
- Confirm telemetry (token counts, latency, error rates) dashboards green: OWNER Samir Patel + SRE.

Action Items (assigned):
- Liu Chen: Run final migration dry-run (staging) 2026-03-26 02:00 PT; confirm backups and warm standby. DUE 2026-03-26.
- Liu Chen: Execute one simulated automated rollback in staging and document steps + timings. DUE 2026-03-27.
- Samir Patel: Increase autoscale headroom for launch window + ensure circuit-breaker enabled. DUE 2026-03-28 08:00 PT.
- Maya Singh: Last QA sweep of model outputs against critical prompt set; update regression notes. DUE 2026-03-26 17:00 PT.
- Sofia Martinez: Finalize status page message and internal runbook link; push to confluence. DUE 2026-03-26 12:00 PT.
- Priya Kapoor: Prepare customer-facing FAQ for launch (short doc) and approve copy. DUE 2026-03-26 17:00 PT.
- On-call SRE (TBD): Be available during rollout windows (on-call rotation to be confirmed). DUE 2026-03-28.

Follow-ups from last week:
- Action: Fix intermittent token count discrepancy - OWNER: Liu Chen - STATUS: done (hotfix deployed).
- Action: Add two additional smoke checks for cached prefix eviction - OWNER: Maya Singh - STATUS: in_progress (80%).

Notes / Questions for today's meeting:
- Do we have capacity to run an extra rollback simulation during weekday night without affecting other customers? (ask infra)
- Confirm final on-call schedule for 3/28 launch window - who is primary, who is backup?
- Any last-minute legal/compliance signoffs (Priya)?

Meeting prep checklist for attendees:
- Read linked runbook and Confluence draft before meeting.
- Bring updates on your assigned checklist items.
- Be ready to mark green/yellow/red and call go/no-go for your area.

Next sync: 2026-03-26 09:30 PT (final pre-launch readiness). If major blocker remains, schedule extra check-in 3/27 evening.

-- Sofia
(Notes: informal scratchpad - keep this doc as working notes; will publish finalized checklist to confluence when stable.)
